description: This file declares the 'tlvf_airties_utils' class with static methods to add various TLV (Type-Length-Value) information related to Airties devices to a 'CmduMessageTx'. It is part of the 'airties' namespace and includes function declarations for adding device info, version reporting, device metrics, and Ethernet interface TLVs.

classes.name: tlvf_airties_utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for adding specific Airties device information TLVs to a CMDU message.

methods.name: add_airties_deviceinfo_tlv
methods.description: Adds an Airties device info TLV to the provided CMDU message.

methods.name: add_airties_version_reporting_tlv
methods.description: Adds a version reporting TLV for Airties devices to the CMDU message.

methods.name: add_device_metrics
methods.description: Adds device metrics TLV to the CMDU message.

methods.name: add_airties_ethernet_interface_tlv
methods.description: Adds Ethernet interface information TLV for Airties devices.
